title: Starting Settlement Term by Charged-Off Balance and Age of the Charge-Off
content:
**Rule.** For a Charged-Off Settlement Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, the starting term for a settlement is set by the charged-off balance of the Personal Loans loan and the time since its charge-off. The charged-off balance is the loan's unpaid principal plus its unpaid fees on the day the term is recorded. A charged-off balance under 6000.00 USD allows one installment for each full 750.00 USD of that balance, any remainder below a full step being dropped; a charged-off balance of 6000.00 USD or more on a loan charged off at least 18 whole calendar months earlier allows 24 installments less the whole calendar months elapsed since the charge-off date, so that the term runs out near the account's sale review, a month counting as complete only when the later date reaches the charge-off day of the month and a loan with no charge-off date recorded counting no months since charge-off; any other charged-off balance allows the program's most settlement installments.

## Decision table

| Charged-off balance | Whole calendar months since charge-off | Starting term |
|---|---|---|
| under 6000.00 USD | any | one installment per full 750.00 USD of the balance |
| 6000.00 USD or more | 18 or more | 24 less the whole months elapsed since the charge-off date |
| 6000.00 USD or more | fewer than 18, or no charge-off date recorded | the program's most settlement installments |

## Worked cases (hypothetical balances and dates)

- Unpaid principal 2,800.00 USD plus unpaid fees 199.99 USD: balance 2,999.99 USD; 3 full steps of 750.00, starting term 3.
- Balance 3,000.00 USD: exactly 4 full steps, starting term 4.
- Balance 6,400.00 USD, charged off on 10 January, term recorded on 10 September of the following year: 20 whole months, starting term 4.
- Same balance and charge-off date, term recorded on 9 July of the following year: 17 whole months (the 10th has not been reached), so the program's most settlement installments apply.
